mapper.select: SELECT T.PVALUEID, T.ASSETTYPE, T.FIRSTTYPE, T.ASSETCODE, T.ASSETNAME, T.INVTGOALS, T.ASSETMDATE, T.FACEAMT, T.CCY, T.BASIS, T.CPRICE, ABS(T.ASSETVALUE) ASSETVALUE, T.DURATION, T.CHANNEL, '' MGRACCT, STL.SEC_ACCT_NAME BONDACCT, T.INVTYIELD * 100 INVTYIELD, T.EXCHANGE FROM PRD_VALUATION_DETAIL T JOIN PRD_VALUATION VAL ON T.PVALUEID = VAL.VALUEID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT INFO ON VAL.PRODCODE = INFO.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO STL ON T.BONDACCT = STL.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE T.VLTYPE = #{vltype, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND INFO.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND TO_CHAR(T.PVALUEID) = #{pvalueid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY CASE WHEN T.ASSETTYPE = 'HQZH' THEN 1 WHEN T.ASSETTYPE = 'HOLDCASH' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END

SELECT T.VALUEID, T.VLDATE, T.PRODCODE, T.PROD4SHORT, T.PROFITTYPE, T.PRODNETASSET, T.PRODTOTQTY, T.UNPAYPROFIT, T.YIELD, T.TOTYIELD, T.NETVALUE, T.TOTNETVALUE, T.CURYIELD, T.TOTCURYIELD, T.YIELD7 FROM PRD_VALUATION T WHERE TO_CHAR(T.VALUEID) = #{valueid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
